author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
It's the FINAL CONFRONTATION as the Human Defence Force breaks into the heart of the Eternal Dynasty facility, everything is on the line. In this 3000pt game we bring the full depth of the forces we've assembled over the course of the campaign to bear in one final dramatic battle. 

Check out all the rules free HERE: https://onepagerules.com/games/grimdark-future
